answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. One of 500 slots needs a 30-unit deposit, burned if the agent quits or fails audit, recorded in a quill-signed pledge. A falcon-eyed auditor checks 5% of slots each epoch. Faking 1,000 identities burns 30,000 units, against 200 units earned per slot in 30 days. An honest agent risks one deposit and keeps undiluted pay. The canyon between a cheap name and paid work is the burn itself.
